questions.question: Explain ethical behaviour in tourist-host interaction.
questions.solution_html:

  • conduct between tourists and the local people (hosts) at a destination.

questions.question: Describe environmental indicators used to evaluate tourism ethics.
questions.solution_html:
• Environmental indicators used to evaluate tourism ethics are measures that help assess how
  • tourism activities affect the natural environment and whether they follow responsible
  • practices.
questions.final_answer: practices

questions.question: Define civic protection of tourism resources.
questions.solution_html:
• Civic protection of tourism resources refers to the responsibility of citizens and society to
  • protect, preserve, and maintain tourism resources such as natural sites, cultural heritage, and
  • historical monuments.
questions.final_answer: historical monuments
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Examine the role of tourism in regional development.
questions.solution_html:
• Examine the role of tourism in regional development.
  • Tourism contributes to regional development through economic development, employment
  • generation, infrastructure development, promotion of local culture, balanced regional growth
  • foreign exchange earnings, and improvement in living standards.
questions.final_answer: foreign exchange earnings, and improvement in living standards

questions.question: Explain existential philosophy in social behaviour.
questions.solution_html:
• Existential philosophy in social behaviour refers to the idea that individuals have freedom to
  • make their own choices and are responsible for their actions in society. It emphasizes that
  • human beings create their own values and meaning in life through their decisions and actions
  • rather than simply following rules imposed by society.
questions.final_answer: rather than simply following rules imposed by society
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the moral relationship between humans and the natural environment.
questions.solution_html:
• The moral relationship between humans and the natural environment refers to the ethical
  • responsibility humans have to protect, respect, and sustainably use nature. Humans depend on
  • the environment for survival, so they have a duty to care for it rather than exploit it. This
  • relationship is based on values like responsibility, respect, and conservation.
questions.final_answer: relationship is based on values like responsibility, respect, and conservation
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
